facts.fact: 叙述者回到自己房间，用几束荆豆和一块拳头大的泥炭在壁炉里生火。
facts.anchor: I made a fire in the hearth from a few bundles of furze and a fist-size chunk of peat

facts.fact: 叙述者感到自己人生的幕布被拉开，看清了被对自己隐瞒十八年的事。
facts.anchor: The curtain had been pulled back on my life, and I saw what had been kept hidden from me for eighteen years

facts.fact: 叙述者得知 Tamsin Griggs 的母亲在叙述者出生时救过其命。
facts.anchor: mother had saved my life at birth

facts.fact: 叙述者自问 Tamsin 是否早在两人在 Carn Kerys 偶然相遇前就已知情，并觉得那不可能。
facts.anchor: we met by chance at Carn Kerys

facts.fact: 叙述者回放 Tamsin 的形象：平静复述可怕之事，以及曾用折刀袭击自己的突然暴力。
facts.anchor: her calm recitation of terrible things; her sudden violence in attacking me with the penknife

facts.fact: 叙述者补上 Tamsin 父母双亡、身为孤儿的一笔。
facts.anchor: the tragedy of her parents’ deaths. She was an orphan

facts.fact: 叙述者觉得这一切像自己父亲的情节剧活生生上演。
facts.anchor: one of my father’s melodramas come to life

facts.fact: 叙述者自认几天前还不知道 Tamsin Griggs 存在，如今觉得没有她宁愿去死。
facts.anchor: Now I would sooner die than live without her
